text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Mejiro Ramonu wasn't feeling 
well, I suggested visiting a shrine to 
pray, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Feel free to pray all you like, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I think I'll stroll around a bit longer.

Mejiro Ramonu walks away. It seems she has 
no intention of making an offering. I 
suppose I'll offer a prayer on her behalf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Sister's... Are you here to visit the 
shrine as well?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. It doesn't look like she'll do it, 
so I'll do it instead

Yes. Since she doesn't seem inclined to, 
I'll do it instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I passed by her a moment ago. It seems 
my sister 'no longer' prays, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um... you know that there was a period 
when my sister couldn't run, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ever since she became able to run, I have 
never seen my sister pray...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That is why I had wondered if that might 
be the case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Praying and praying... Did they come to 
think that prayer was meaningless—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, she feels she has already 
prayed enough for a lifetime—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I cannot say for certain what the truth of 
the matter is, but... —Please take good 
care of my sister.

After Mejiro Ardan walked away, I offered 
a respectful prayer before the altar.

I had been praying so earnestly that 
evening had already arrived. It seemed I 
kept Mejiro Ramonu waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The setting sun melts away, drops from the 
heavens—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Could you fetch my art supplies for me? 
Before the sun sets, if you please.
choice_data_list: Looks like I could paint a great picture!

Looks like we could paint a great picture, 
huh!

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu lets her pen glide across 
the paper in the glow of dusk. Though the 
scenery sank into twilight, the sun was 
rising in her eyes.

Her brush moved with powerful, unwavering 
strokes. It seemed Mejiro Ramonu had 
regained her form.

After finishing our shrine visit, Mejiro 
Ramonu was waiting on the temple grounds. 
The atmosphere felt somewhat prickly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Part of the shrine approach was under 
construction. It completely ruined the 
mood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Let's head home now.

Mejiro Ramonu murmured in a shadowed tone 
of voice. Her slump was set to continue...
